summary: QTREX Quantum Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 17, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the appointment of Dr. Shlomit Chappel-Ram as an independent director, effective July 14, 2026. The filing is a routine disclosure of a board appointment; no financial terms, transaction value, premium, or other deal mechanics are involved. The announcement references QTREX's prior acquisition of an AME platform from Nano Dimension in April 2026 but does not describe a new special situation. This is an ordinary current report of a management change, not a forced departure, and thus does not qualify as a special-situation event.
